static_traits.name: Li Wei
static_traits.family_status: Mother was a Teacher, taught for over twenty years, Unemployment a few months ago
static_traits.social_status: Have a few friends to confide in, but have not yet fully expressed Anxiety and worries; relationships with friends affected by Persistent anxiety
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; have not yet received counseling or treatment before; no similar MotherWork-related psychological issues before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic; able to describe Anxiety and negative thoughts concretely; fairly cooperative, willing to try Intervention; tone and content show marked worry and catastrophizing, a thinking tendency of predicting the future

basic_info.main_problem: I have been struggling with the belief that 'my Mother can never find as good a Work as before', which causes me great pain and Anxiety.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because Anxiety and worry about my Mother's Work situation have almost consumed me, affecting my daily life and causing pain. I hope to manage these intense worries and stop feeling overwhelmed.
growth_experiences: Mother worked as a Teacher for over 20 years and loved her Work; a few months ago after Mother's Unemployment, Li Wei began constantly worrying about Mother's future career and financial stability; over time, seeing Mother's job-search setbacks (e.g. applications and rejections) further reinforced his negative Anticipation, leading to Sleep disturbance, appetite changes, Decline in work performance and Tense relationships with friends.

core_beliefs: Absolute negative beliefs about Mother's employment: Mother can never find as good a Work as before

special_situations.event: Mother's Unemployment a few months ago
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If Mother cannot find Work equal to or better than before, her life will be long-term unstable and unhappy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously comfort and provide support, excessively watch and monitor Mother's job-search progress to gain a sense of control
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She can never return to her former stability and satisfaction

special_situations.event: Moments when Mother mentions submitting resumes or receiving rejection letters
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once a rejection letter appears, it means future rejections will continue, and career prospects are thoroughly bleak
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly think of the worst outcomes, avoid fully expressing my worries to Mother and friends so as not to add to their pressure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Being rejected again this time, will keep Being rejected in the future

special_situations.event: Noticing Mother's slow job-search progress or difficulties
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: No obvious progress now means there will be no good outcomes in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on negative information, ignoring possible positive signs or alternative opportunities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Her future will only get worse, with no positive possibilities

special_situations.event: Distraction by Mother's job search when interacting with friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not keep worrying and try to control the situation, I am being irresponsible, unable to protect Mother
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces sharing true feelings with friends, keeping worries in my heart to maintain superficial stability
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I must worry constantly and cannot let up

core_conflict.wish: Long to protect and ensure Mother's career and life stability, to be needed and useful
core_conflict.fear: Fear of losing control over Mother's future, fear that Mother suffers while I am powerless to change the situation
defense_goal: Gains a sense of control by maintaining hypervigilance and worry
Avoid expressing my own emotions to avoid adding pressure on Mother and friends

object_relations.self_representation: A heavily burdened caregiver who must take responsibility
object_relations.object_representation: A vulnerable Mother who needs help and protection

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When Mother receives a rejection letter or mentions unsmooth job-search progress
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treat each rejection letter as evidence of long-term failure, believing the future is doomed to be bleak (jumping to conclusions, catastrophizing)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Keep tone gentle and steady, first Empathy and validate their Anxiety, then invite distinguishing possibilities from evidence, focusing on concrete present information and actionable ways to support.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised or thinking of honestly expressing my stress and feelings to Mother or friends
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing expression will burden others and worsen relationships, so best not to say
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Use a supportive, non-judgmental tone, affirm their motivation of being considerate of others, propose small-step attempts at safe self-disclosure, set clear boundaries and goals, and encourage distinguishing facts from assumptions.

manifestations: Worry about adding pressure on Mother and friends and thus unwilling to fully express my pain
Feel like carrying a burden that cannot be put down, bearing it alone
Difficulty seeing positive possibilities after repeated rejection letters
Tending to only imagine the worst outcome, hard to give meaning to current efforts
outcomes: Attention and Decline in work performance

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: not fully express my stress and Anxiety to Mother and friends
Internalizes worries and burdens, bearing them alone

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Constrain myself with rules like 'I must worry constantly and cannot let up'
Internalize the creed 'must protect Mother' as self-reproach

positive_force: Willing to try cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments
Has a small amount of social support (some friends to talk with)
Have stable caring and supportive motivation toward Mother
Able to notice myself in A thinking pattern of catastrophizing and predicting the future
negative_force: Cognitive biases of catastrophizing and fortune telling are prominent
Excessive worry leads to Disturbed sleep and appetite, Decreased work efficiency
Tends to focus only on negative information (mental filtering)
Avoids expressing true feelings; takes on too much responsibility
Self-monitoring and self-reproach increase psychological burden

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive worry and catastrophic Anticipation about Mother's job search (Persistent anxiety)
antecedent: Notice Mother's slow or frustrated job-search progress
Recall worst-case scenarios and future uncertainty
target_behavior.core_reason: Tendency to imagine the worst endings and treat each rejection letter as evidence of long-term failure, intolerant of uncertainty and gaining a sense of control through worry
target_behavior.function: Escape uncertainty and loss of control, gaining subjective control and a sense of responsibility through constant worry
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep disturbance, appetite changes, Decline in work performance, Tense relationships with friends, Anxiety keeps worsening

target_behavior.behavior: Avoid fully expressing my own stress and feelings to Mother and friends
antecedent: When thinking of communicating my own feelings with Mother or friends
When advised to share more emotionally
target_behavior.core_reason: Worry that expressing will add to their pressure or worsen relationships, thus choosing Repression and hiding
target_behavior.function: Avoid causing others worry or conflict, maintaining surface stability and Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: Increased Loneliness and burden, Anxiety maintained, Insufficient use of social support
